import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem odd_power_geometric_factorization (b n q : ℕ) (hdecomp : b = 3 * q + 2) : ((b : ℤ) ^ (2 * n + 1) + 1 = ((b : ℤ) + 1) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * n - k)) ∧ (b : ℤ) + 1 = 3 * (q + 1) := by
  constructor
  · have H : ((b : ℤ) + 1) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * n - k) =
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * n + 1), (((-1 : ℤ) ^ k * (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * n + 1 - k)) - ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (k + 1) * (b : ℤ) ^ (2 * n + 1 - (k + 1)))) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      have hk' : 2 * n + 1 - k = (2 * n - k) + 1 := by
        have : k < 2 * n + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
        omega
      have hk2 : 2 * n + 1 - (k + 1) = 2 * n - k := by omega
      rw [hk', hk2, pow_succ]
      ring
    rw [H, Finset.sum_range_sub']
    have hpow : (-1 : ℤ) ^ (2 * n + 1) = -1 := by
      rw [pow_add, pow_mul, pow_one]
      have : (-1 : ℤ) ^ 2 = 1 := rfl
      rw [this, one_pow, one_mul]
    have hzero : 2 * n + 1 - 0 = 2 * n + 1 := by omega
    have hsub : 2 * n + 1 - (2 * n + 1) = 0 := by omega
    rw [hzero, hsub, hpow]
    ring
  · omega
